Unset data_as_elements uses span and div for data-as

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
